title: NDP 2026: Showtime
description: The show is live, millions watching — and the livestream starts buffering.
storyContext: The show is live. Millions streaming at home. Then the video freezes and social media erupts. Twenty minutes to the fireworks finale. The whole nation is watching you.

software-engineer.title: Fix the Livestream
software-engineer.instruction: The stream is freezing for millions. Twenty minutes to fireworks. Your move.

options.label: Lower video quality. Smooth playback instantly — but the drone show won't look as crisp.
options.consequence: The buffering stops dead. The drones look slightly soft. Social media complains, then watches anyway.

options.label: Spin up extra machines to share the load. Burns 10 of your 20 minutes; perfect quality if it works.
options.consequence: Ten sweaty minutes... then crystal-clear video for millions. Biggest gamble of your life pays off.

options.label: Switch to a backup streaming network. Quick to activate, but you lose some viewer statistics.
options.consequence: The backup network takes the load like a champ. The analytics team lights a candle for the lost stats.

options.label: Smart streaming — each viewer gets the best quality their connection handles. Nobody freezes; not everyone gets HD.
options.consequence: Freezing stops for everyone at once. Some watch in HD, some in potato-vision, all see the finale.

data-scientist.title: Predict Viewer Drop-off
data-scientist.instruction: Viewers are bailing while the stream stutters. The graph shows thousands watching each minute. How many at the next check?
data-scientist.hint: Is the drop steady, speeding up, or slowing? Carry it forward.
data-scientist.consequenceSuccess: Your forecast lands. The team knows exactly how long they have before the audience is gone.
data-scientist.consequenceFail: The audience drains faster than your maths. Trend lines don't care about feelings. Recheck the drops.

cloud-engineer.title: Spread the Load
cloud-engineer.instruction: The main system is drowning. Shift traffic to backups — one mistake and the stream goes dark.
cloud-engineer.hint: Prep backups before sending traffic. Test small before going all-in.

items.label: Check the backups are healthy and ready
Update routing so traffic can reach them
Load the latest video onto the backups
Send 30% of traffic over as a test

cloud-engineer.consequenceSuccess: Traffic glides across the backups. The stream steadies just as the first firework lifts. Chef's kiss.
cloud-engineer.consequenceFail: You shift traffic to cold backups and they choke. Warm-up first, spotlight second.
